// CASE dart_outer_loop_inner_awaited_iterable expect=fire
Future<int> total(List<String> companies, Store store) async {
  var sum = 0;
  for (final company in companies) {
    for (final row in await store.listRows(company)) {
      sum += row.amount;
    }
  }
  return sum;
}
// CASE dart_outer_while_inner_awaited_iterable expect=fire
Future<void> drain(Queue<String> pending, Store store) async {
  while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
    final id = pending.removeFirst();
    for (final row in await store.listRows(id)) {
      print(row);
    }
  }
}
// CASE dart_single_loop_awaited_iterable expect=pass
Future<int> single(Store store) async {
  var sum = 0;
  for (final row in await store.listRows('a')) {
    sum += row.amount;
  }
  return sum;
}
